summary: Summary of XSS findings for result.json
body:
Found XSS vectors: 1. Reflected XSS via search q parameter: Angular SPA's search component reads `q` from route snapshot, passes through `bypassSecurityTrustHtml()`, renders via `[innerHTML]`. Source code evidence: `this.searchValue=this.sanitizer.bypassSecurityTrustHtml(e)` and `h("innerHTML",e.searchValue,Je)`. 2. Stored XSS via product reviews: PUT /rest/products/1/reviews stores unsanitized HTML. Verified payloads ``, ``, and `` stored as-is. 3. Stored XSS via feedback: Feedback comments rendered via bypassSecurityTrustHtml but server-side filter strips dangerous tags. Allows ``, `
`, ``. 4. Stored XSS in product descriptions: Descriptions rendered via bypassSecurityTrustHtml, some products already contain HTML tags.
